text:
Maya: Quick sync — after the launch telemetry spike we need a short roster of low-risk, high-impact follow-on slices to push in the next 2 sprints. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

AJ: Agree. We should prioritize things that reduce customer pain and can ship without infra changes. My top picks: 1) Rate-limit error handling (manifesting as 429s for some accounts), 2) UI copy fixes for streaming progress, 3) Small embed quality regression rollback for the top 10 customers.

Taylor: +1 to rate-limit and streaming copy. For embed rollback, is there a safe way to canary it? We should avoid a big blast radius.

Maya: For canarying, we can route 5% traffic for affected orgs to the previous model version and run perf/quality checks for 48h. If metrics hold, promote. That avoids infra work.

Sam: Concrete breakouts:
- Rate-limit error handling: 1 dev, 1 QA, small server patch to retry with exponential backoff and a 1s jitter. Target: one-day patch + canary.
- Streaming UI copy: small UX + engineering tweak, docs update. Target: half-day.
- Embed rollback: Ops + ML to pin previous model for selected orgs, plus alerting. Target: 3 days with canary.

AJ: We should also include a hygiene ticket: backlog grooming to tag items by risk and rollback plan. Last launch showed we lacked explicit rollbacks for a few changes.

Taylor: I can own the grooming ticket. Proposal: a 60-minute async session tomorrow — I’ll post a Loom with the triage rubric (impact, risk, rollback complexity).

Maya: Sounds good. Can we add acceptance criteria for each quick slice so PMs and eng know what 'done' means? Example for rate-limit: "no client sees >1% 429s in 24h after deploy; retries succeed for transient spikes".

Sam: Adding that now to the ticket. Also attaching a tiny playbook snippet for the retry patch:
```
# pseudocode retry
for attempt in range(MAX_RETRIES):
  res = call_service()
  if res.ok: break
  sleep(backoff(attempt)) + jitter()
```

AJ: Nice. Ops note: monitor p99 latency as a guardrail for the retry. If p99 jumps >30%, abort canary.

Taylor: UX note: update streaming progress to show last-updated chunk and a soft CTA to retry if stalls >8s. Keeps customers informed.

Maya: Who volunteers to take the rate-limit patch as lead? I can slot it into my day if no objections.

AJ: I can pair on QA and test harness for retries.

Sam: I’ll handle the embed canary orchestration with ML infra. Need a list of affected orgs — @Maya can you surface the top 10 by error rate?

Maya: On it, will drop IDs in the ticket.

DeployBot: [deploy-notice] Canary rollout plan created for rate-limit patch -> canary window 2h, rollback automated on alert threshold.

Taylor: Next steps recap: 1) Taylor: create grooming Loom + rubric, 2) Maya: list top-10 orgs + ticket ACs, 3) Sam: prepare canary ops playbook for embed rollback, 4) AJ: QA harness + p99 guard. Ship targets: rate-limit patch (1 day), streaming copy (0.5 day), embed canary (3 days).

Maya: Thanks — I'll create the sprint slices and tag owners. If anyone has pushback on scope, flag here today. :thumbsup:
